page.title: App Market
page.description: Discover, open, and manage your live apps, shared apps, and drafts in one place.
page.empty: No apps yet. Start building with the Agent above, then publish when you are ready.

createWithAgent.title: Describe the app you want
createWithAgent.description: Write a short brief — we open an Agent conversation so you can build it together.
createWithAgent.placeholder: e.g. A simple sales dashboard with weekly charts…
createWithAgent.error: Failed to start the Agent conversation.

suggestions.label: Try an idea
suggestions.dashboard: A simple sales dashboard with weekly charts
suggestions.tasks: A task tracker with priorities and due dates
suggestions.form: A contact form that sends an email confirmation

all.label: All
all.description: Every app in your catalog — deployed, shared, and drafts.

deployed.label: Deployed
deployed.description: Live applications you published and can open, share, or manage.
deployed.empty: No deployed apps yet. Publish from a conversation to see them here.

shared.label: Shared
shared.description: Applications teammates shared with you, ready to open.
shared.empty: Nothing shared with you yet. When someone shares an app, it appears here.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Work-in-progress apps that are not published yet.
draft.empty: No drafts yet. Keep building in a conversation and publish when ready.

filters.aiOnlyHint: Show only apps with AI features

card.liveHint: Live application — open it, share it, or manage end users.
card.sharedHint: Shared with you — open the live app when you need it.
card.draftHint: Not published yet — continue in the conversation to deploy.
card.deleteDescription: The conversation and hosted app will be kept. Publishing again will add it back to App Builder.
card.deleteDraftDescription: This permanently deletes the associated conversation. This action cannot be undone.
card.unshareDescription: This only removes the app from your App Builder. The owner's conversation stays private.
card.unshareSuccess: Shared app removed from your App Builder.
card.unshareError: Failed to remove the shared app.

endUsers.title: App users & permissions
endUsers.description: Registered users and their permissions for this deployed app.
endUsers.hint: New users have no permissions by default. Explicitly grant the access they need.
endUsers.empty: People who register on your deployed app will appear here.

presets.label: Apply preset
presets.hint: CRUD presets do not change AI usage — toggle AI separately.

templates.heading: Templates
templates.empty: No templates are available in this view.
templates.formDescription: Upload a React/Vite project ZIP and one or more cover images.
templates.coverFromValidation: A cover was generated from the NodePod preview. Add more images or adjust the focus zone.

coverGallery.empty: Add at least one cover image. The primary image is used on the template card.
coverGallery.tip: Click an image to frame the focus zone. Mark one as primary for the marketplace card.

coverFocus.title: Cover focus
coverFocus.description: Drag the frame and zoom to choose what appears on the template card.
coverFocus.dragHint: Drag the bright frame to reposition. Use zoom for a tighter crop.
coverFocus.aspectHint: The visible area matches the card ratio ({{aspect}}).

templateModal.startHint: Describe what you want to build. The agent opens a session with this template already loaded.
templateModal.placeholder: e.g. Customize this template for my use case…
templateModal.error: Failed to start the conversation from this template.

admin.deleteCategoryDescription: Deleting "{{name}}" also removes all its templates. This cannot be undone.
admin.deleteTemplateDescription: "{{name}}" and its stored source will be removed. This cannot be undone.

platformReport.heading: Platform compatibility
platformReport.ready: Ready — this template already ships the platform layer.
platformReport.needsNormalization: {{count}} platform file(s) will be added automatically when a session starts.
platformReport.incompatible: This template cannot be normalized automatically.

dropZone.prompt: Drag & drop or click to select

validation.title: Validate in NodePod
validation.zipDescription: The uploaded ZIP is started in a NodePod preview. A cover screenshot is taken when the app is ready.
validation.statusConfirmed: Confirmed — the template runs in NodePod.
